segments.text: Twelve o'clock, noon: the Sun vanishes.
Then the whole daytime side of Earth goes dark at once.
But the darkness doesn't stop at Earth.
About thirteen minutes after the Sun vanishes, the darkness reaches Mars. After forty-three minutes, Jupiter. After four hours, Neptune.
And a full day later, it reaches the farthest thing humans have ever built. Voyager 1 is now one light-day from Earth.
Out there, the Sun is just a bright star, and for eight minutes, it would go missing.
So Voyager would be the last one to find out. Classic.
